claims.says: Round trip is roughly 18 miles with 7,000+ ft of elevation gain, typically done over 2-3 days
16.8 (cumulative one-way distance from the trailhead)

contradictions.why: The header Dist figure implied by dist_km (~9.0 mi) is roughly half of the approach prose's explicit 'roughly 18 miles' round trip, and the waypoints' own cumulative one-way distance to the summit (16.8 mi) implies an even longer round trip (~33.6 mi) if the descent reverses the ascent — three different figures for what should be the same round-trip distance.
contradictions.internal_resolution: the approach prose's gain figure ('7,000+ ft') matches gain_ft (7200), so the prose is likely reliable on distance too; dist_km (9.0 mi) looks too short to be the round-trip figure and gain_ft/approach/waypoints all point to a much longer trip.

contradictions.fact: Total time vs its own sub-components
contradictions.why: On every other route in this batch, totalHrs equals the sum of approachTimeHrs+summitTimeHrs+descentTimeHrs. Here the three sub-times sum to 17 hrs, not the stated totalHrs of 13 — a 4-hour (~31%) discrepancy that would show up as PUBLISHED TIMES fields not adding up.
contradictions.internal_resolution: summitTimeHrs+descentTimeHrs (12) matches the itinerary text's '12-13+ hour day' for the climbing day alone; totalHrs (13) appears to cover only that day and to omit approachTimeHrs (5), unlike the pattern on sibling routes in this set.
